title: MapDefs
description: Shared definitions for the map data model: the HEAD tables' vocabulary (db/schema.sql) and GeoJSON geometry in WGS84. Used by the public snapshot files (docs/snapshot-format.md) and the change-set diff (docs/diff-format.md). uuid, sha256, dateTime and anchorKind are the capture bundle's definitions, so each has one type across the formats. Not a file: the other schemas reference these with $ref.

position.title: Position
position.description: [longitude, latitude] in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), with at most 7 decimals (about 1 cm). No altitude: height is levels.elevation_m. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: the latitude is between -90 and 90, and the decimals.

lineString.title: LineStringGeometry
lineString.description: A GeoJSON LineString of 2 to 10000 positions.

linearRing.title: LinearRing
linearRing.description: A closed ring of 4 to 10000 positions: the exterior ring of a polygon counterclockwise, holes clockwise (RFC 7946). Checked by the validator, not by this schema: the last position equals the first.

polygon.title: PolygonGeometry
polygon.description: A GeoJSON Polygon: an exterior ring, then up to 99 holes.

multiPolygon.title: MultiPolygonGeometry
multiPolygon.description: A GeoJSON MultiPolygon of 1 to 100 polygons, each an exterior ring then up to 99 holes.

ordinal.title: Ordinal
ordinal.description: Display band of a level for the level switcher: 0 street, -1 the first basement band, and so on (levels.ordinal, a smallint). Several levels may share a band; it says nothing exact about height, and routing never infers a connection from equal ordinals.

smallint.title: Smallint
smallint.description: An integer within the range of a PostgreSQL smallint.

osmId.title: OsmId
osmId.description: An OpenStreetMap node or way id (a bigint; below 2^53, so exact as a JSON number).

openingHours.title: OpeningHours
openingHours.description: Opening hours in OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax, evaluated in Asia/Singapore time, for example "Mo-Su 06:00-24:00".

venueKind.title: VenueKind
venueKind.description: Kind of venue: the venue_kind values in db/schema.sql.

spaceKind.title: SpaceKind
spaceKind.description: Kind of space: the space_kind values in db/schema.sql. fare_zone is an MRT paid area.

nodeKind.title: NodeKind
nodeKind.description: Kind of node: the node_kind values in db/schema.sql. escalator, lift, stairs, travelator and ramp nodes are landings: one per end, or one per lift stop, grouped by connector_id.

edgeKind.title: EdgeKind
edgeKind.description: Kind of edge: the edge_kind values in db/schema.sql. escalator, stairs, lift, ramp and travelator edges are vertical connectors between landings; street is an outdoor link mapped between indoor nodes where OpenStreetMap has none.

edgeAccess.title: EdgeAccess
edgeAccess.description: Who may use an edge: the edge_access values in db/schema.sql. Routing avoids paid_fare_zone (MRT paid areas) and customers_only edges by default.

poiCategory.title: PoiCategory
poiCategory.description: Category of a point of interest: the poi_category values in db/schema.sql.

streetPriorSource.title: StreetPriorSource
streetPriorSource.description: Where an anchor's street prior came from: the street_prior_source values in db/schema.sql.
